# Installation

FLicc is on the henning-winker r-universe, together with its FLR dependencies from the FLR
r-universe. This installs FLicc and everything it needs, with ready-built binaries for Windows and
macOS (no Rtools needed):

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
install.packages("FLicc", repos = c("https://henning-winker.r-universe.dev",
                                    "https://flr.r-universe.dev",
                                    "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

The development version from GitHub needs the dependencies first and, on Windows, Rtools
(<https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/>) to compile the TMB model:

```{r install-github, eval = FALSE}
install.packages("TMB", type = "source")
install.packages(c("FLCore", "ggplotFL"),
                 repos = c("https://flr.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
remotes::install_github("henning-winker/FLicc")
```

```{r load}
library(FLicc)
packageVersion("FLicc")
```
